displayDescription: A yellow clay idea drops onto a kraft tabletop and clay coils connect it, exposure by exposure, to four clay blocks.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.186.1 WebGLRenderer (procedural clay geometry, MeshStandardMaterial, PCF soft shadow maps), bundled locally with esbuild to scene.bundle.js
Canvas 2D procedural textures (backdrop paint, kraft card, clay bump)
HTML/CSS + inline SVG digital title and exposure-strip layer
motionEngine: GSAP 3 paused timeline at window.__timelines.video (owns composition time and title-layer opacity/x/y)
Deterministic exposure-quantized pose functions (12 exposures/s) evaluated from timeline time on every update and hf-seek
limitations: Simulated stop motion: frames are rendered by Three.js from discrete held poses, not photographed; per-exposure placement offsets are seeded, not real handling.
Clay surfaces are approximated with procedural vertex lumps and a canvas bump map; no subsurface scattering or real fingerprints.
The painted backdrop is unlit (baked falloff) so title contrast stays predictable; it receives no shadows.
No depth-of-field blur; Blender was not used, per the user's instruction.
STYLE.json contains no tech.preview_recipes, so no reviewed recipe is demonstrated.
Silent: no soundtrack was requested for this preview.
